page.layout: One printed page, single text column. Above the text: a woodcut ornamental frieze (not text), then a centred title block with a running title line, a subtitle in italics, and a large decorated initial opening the first paragraph. Page number at the top right. Signature at the foot right.

main_text.head: BRVTVM FVLMEN PAPÆ SIXTI V. ADVERSVS HENRICVM SERENISSIMVM Regem Nauarræ, & illustriss. Henricum Borbonium, Principem Condæum.
Vnà cum protestatione & declaratione multiplicis nullitatis.
main_text.p: VOD nuper à Papa Sixto quinto Franciscano pronuntiata Declaratio est, paulóque póst edita & promulgata, vt Henricus Sereniss. Rex Nauarræ, itémque Henricus Borbonius Illustrissimus Princeps Condæus primùm tanquam hæretici notorij ex communione Christianorum arcerentur, tum vt imperiis, honoribus, dignitatibus omnibus, ac potissimùm spe legitimæ successionis regni Galliæ abdicarentur: deinde vt eorum clientes ac vassalli fidelitatis iuramento, quo illis obstricti sunt, soluerentur: postremò vt à potentissimo Rege Galliæ vi, ferro, armis, & castris oppugnarentur: DE EA RE Supradicti Serenissimi & Illustrissimi Principes ita protestati sunt: bona Catholicorum omnium pace, saluáque religionis vtriusque concordia, quam iidem Principes magnopere in Gallia conseruari cupiunt, proscriptionem, siue DECLARATIONEM illam

page.notes: Woodcut initial "O" at the start of the first paragraph is decorative; the first word is read as VOD (the letter "O" is the initial, shown as a decorated capital, so the word is printed "VOD" with the initial). Doubtful: "illam" line ends the page at the foot; the continuation is not on this page. Printed "vt eorum" and "vt" spellings kept as printed. Words "Declaratio est" kept with printed long-s forms transcribed as s.
